{{Top|leg}}
An '''axial piston''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component. [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droids]] had axial pistons in their necks. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] believed that his axial pistons had not being quite right since he had been reassembled by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] after an encounter with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[3 ABY/Legends|seven]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] previously.
